text: {"people":[{"name":"Priya","relationship":"manager","observations":["Jordan is writing the dashboard documentation for whoever Priya assigns after the 21st","Jordan has six days until a meeting with Priya"]},{"name":"Dev","relationship":"friend","observations":["Dev's session on the 3rd broke something open that led to the free-play review screen fix Jordan carried around for twelve days"]},{"name":"Pepper","relationship":"pet","observations":["Pepper sat on the back of the couch watching the window like she was expecting someone"]}],"projects":[{"name":"analytics dashboard","domain":"work","status":"active","observations":["Jordan spent most of the afternoon writing documentation for it, with screenshots and flow diagrams","Jordan wants the dashboard to outlive their tenure at Meridian because it actually helps people"]},{"name":"free-play review screen","domain":"personal","status":"active","observations":["Jordan finally rebuilt it at Groundwork after carrying the fix around for twelve days","Replaced highlights with neutral marks, and the review step asks what a mark means instead of telling you","Removed the 'your best moments' header and highlight reel","Took two hours and Jordan threw out more code than they wrote","The trophy-case framing affected export naming, share text, and the summary card","Ran a test session, marked four spots, and the review asked about each one"]}],"places":[{"name":"Groundwork","kind":"cafe","observations":["Jordan went there after work, had a cortado at a window table with laptop","Rebuilt the free-play review screen there"]},{"name":"Meridian","kind":"workplace","observations":["Jordan is spending their last good week there","The company plans to replace the site the dashboard is for"]}],"things":[]}
